coverage: 全球基础教育入学、识字率长期提升与低收入国家学习质量差距（Our World in Data 汇总 UNESCO/世界银行数据）
excerpt: The world has gone through a dramatic transition over the last few centuries, from one where very few had any basic education to one where most people do... However, being in school does not guarantee that a child receives a high-quality education. In fact, in many countries, the data shows that children learn very little.
limitation: 页面未标注单一发布日期，且综合了多国多时期数据，不能直接将教育普及和识字率提升单独归因于互联网。

coverage: 世界银行 2025 年《Digital Pathways for Education》报告摘要：全球学习危机、1.3 billion 儿童缺乏家庭互联网、数字技术普及与有效性证据稀缺
excerpt: Over half of 10-year-olds in low- and middle-income countries cannot read and understand an age-appropriate text , and 87 percent of them are in Sub-Saharan Africa. In 2024, 251 million children and young people were out of school... Two thirds of school age children (approx. 1.3 billion globally) do not have access to the internet at home... At the same time, the related systemic investment needs are substantial, evidence of effectiveness is scarce, and risks abound.
limitation: 为报告官方发布页摘要，聚焦全球尤其是中低收入国家的数字教育鸿沟与系统性风险，未按家庭教育氛围分层统计。

coverage: 世界银行教育专家对 2022 年 OECD PISA 评估结果的分析：多数中等收入国家 15 岁学生未达到数学基础熟练度（Level 2）且较 2018 年下滑
excerpt: The newly published results of the 2022 Program for International Student Assessment (PISA) showed that in the wake of the pandemic in many countries, most children are not learning even the basics... Shockingly, in all but four middle-income countries, the majority fall below this minimum standard.
limitation: 主要聚焦中等收入国家及新冠疫情冲击后的 2018-2022 年变化，未包含低收入国家，且成绩下滑受疫情停课等多重因素影响。

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES）IPEDS 高等教育远程/在线课程选修与跨州就读统计（2019-2021 年秋季）
excerpt: In fall 2021, some 9.4 million students, or 61 percent of all undergraduate students, were enrolled in at least one distance education course. Some 4.4 million students, or 28 percent of all undergraduate students, took distance education courses exclusively... 1.0 million (23 percent) were enrolled in institutions in a different state.
limitation: 仅覆盖美国高等教育本科生群体，数据观察至 2021 年秋季，页面未标注具体发布日期。

coverage: Class Central 2021 年度全球 MOOCs 统计：2.2 亿注册学习者（不含中国）、约 950 所大学推出 1.94 万门课程及微证书与在线学位
excerpt: Now, a decade later, MOOCs have reached 220 million learners, excluding China 1 . In 2021, providers launched over 3100 courses and 500 microcredentials... By the end of 2021, 19.4K MOOCs will be announced or launched by around 950 universities worldwide.
limitation: 统计不含中国平台且主要反映注册规模与课程供给，不直接等同于课程完成率或学习成效。

coverage: 世界银行拉美与加勒比地区数字教育项目页：AI 与个性化学习工具应用，以及 PISA 2022 显示的在线学习平台与教师技术整合差距
excerpt: According to PISA 2022 data, only 66% of students in the region attended a school with effective online learning platforms, and barely 3 out of 10 students attended a school whose teachers received incentives to integrate technology into their teaching — a figure that does not even reach half the average of OECD countries.
limitation: 聚焦拉美与加勒比地区，页面未标注单一发布日期（提及自 2024 年起的项目进展）。

coverage: 美国纽约州使用联邦Race to the Top资金开发免费开源K-12课程EngageNY及Great Minds、FedEx等供应商围绕免费材料提供印刷与增值服务竞争（2010–2018）
excerpt: Each of the organizations was also able to publish the materials themselves—many, including Great Minds, began to sell printed copies and other services to districts as a source of additional revenue.
limitation: 以美国纽约州EngageNY与Great Minds v. FedEx案为核心案例；同时指出三大传统出版商（Pearson、McGraw Hill、HMH）最初未参与开源竞标，且CC BY-NC-SA非商业条款曾引发供应商与第三方印刷商的版权诉讼。

coverage: 美国K-12开源数学课程（Open Up Resources / Illustrative Mathematics与UnboundEd）免费开放数字课程并通过付费印刷、教师版改进与专业培训竞争，以及OER可持续性争议（2017）
excerpt: Open Up Resources’ pitch to districts is essentially the inverse: to give the curriculum for free digitially and couple it with high-quality professional development. (The group also offers printing services for a fee for districts that want paper copies.)
limitation: 报道主要聚焦2017年上线初期（逾160个学区订购支持服务），并提及外界质疑OER提供方能否产生足够收入持续更新免费材料（如EngageNY曾面临的更新批评）。

coverage: Bay View Analytics对美国高等教育OER认知度、采用率与配套增值材料质量的长期追踪调查（2009–2022）
excerpt: The only area where OER lag behind commercial materials is in rating the quality of supporting supplemental materials.
limitation: 样本为美国高等教育教师而非K-12学区，但作为开放免费教材生态的反面与边界证据，显示2022年仍有多数教师未采用OER，且OER在配套支持材料方面落后于商业出版商。

coverage: 美国教育部国家教育统计中心（NCES）2023年家长与家庭教育参与全国抽样调查（2022–23学年居家教育、在家上学、部分/全部在线选课比例及家长动机）
excerpt: In the 2022–23 school year, 93 percent took no virtual courses and 7 percent of enrolled or homeschooled students took at least one virtual course. Specifically, 3 percent took all courses virtually, and 5 percent took some but not all courses virtually (table A-8).
limitation: 覆盖美国K-12学生（2022–23学年），虚拟选课数据合并统计了在校生与在家上学学生，未单独细分在家上学群体内部按学科挑选在线课程的比例。

coverage: 哈佛肯尼迪学院PEPG《Education Next》对美国在家上学增长、在线课程降低门槛（如Khan Academy）、混合模式及家长保留课程内容控制权的研究综述（至2022）
excerpt: The availability of online content is revolutionizing the practice. Access to sophisticated instructional material lowers barriers that previously discouraged parents from homeschooling. A parent confident in her ability to teach grammar, spelling, and literature but not in her mastery of long division, algebra, and calculus can now ask her child to turn to Khan Academy or other free or low-cost instruction for help.
limitation: 文章同时指出批评者担忧教学质量参差不齐，且各州对在家上学的记录不完整、部分家庭不愿参与调研，导致研究样本存在潜在偏差。

coverage: 美国国家教育政策中心（NEPC）《2023年美国虚拟学校报告》对全日制公立K-12虚拟学校教学质量与监管绩效的批判性评估（截至2023）
excerpt: Proponents, including business leaders, school reform organizations, foundations, and for-profit and nonprofit service providers, argue that virtual technology will revolutionize teaching and learning, dramatically reduce the cost, and expand the availability of high-quality education. If this sounds too good to be true, it could be because it’s not true.
limitation: 报告主要针对全日制公办K-12虚拟学校而非家长自主管理的传统在家上学，但构成重要边界反证：在线教育供给并非普遍优质，商业化虚拟学校存在质量与监管短板。

coverage: 国际教育技术协会（ISTE）发布的 K-12 教育者标准（涵盖 Collaborator、Designer、Facilitator 等维度），广泛用于美国及国际学校数字时代教师能力框架。
excerpt: Educators use collaborative tools to expand students' authentic, real-world learning experiences by engaging virtually with experts, teams and students , locally and globally. Educators model and nurture creativity and creative expression to communicate ideas, knowledge or connections.
limitation: 属于行业能力标准与框架文件，页面未标注精确修订日期，反映规范性要求与最佳实践定义而非全体教师实际达标率。

coverage: 美国教育部教育技术办公室（OET）2024年7月报告（含2024年国家教育技术计划 NETP 三大数字鸿沟定义与“电动自行车”人机协同原则）。
excerpt: Just as a cyclist controls direction and pace but preserves energy with the assistance of an e-bike’s drivetrain, so should participants in education remain in control and able to apply saved energy and time for the most impactful interactions and activities when technology amplifies their choices and actions.
limitation: 主要聚焦美国 K-12 与教育技术政策框架，且同时指出数字设计鸿沟（Digital Design Divide）、数字接入鸿沟与教师审核负担等现实约束。

coverage: An & Reigeluth (2011–12) 发表在《Journal of Digital Learning in Teacher Education》的同行评审实证研究，调查126名美国 K-12 教师在以学习者为中心的数字课堂中的实践与障碍。
excerpt: About 57% perceived lack of technology and time as a barrier or a major barrier. A little more than half of the participants (51%) perceived assessment as a barrier or a major barrier.
limitation: 样本量为126名美国 K-12 教师，调查时间较早（2011–12年），主要反映中早期数字转型阶段的结构性阻力（时间、设备与高利害考试压力）。

coverage: 科罗拉多大学博尔德分校官方报道（2020年5月4日），记录其 PhET 交互式在线科学/数学模拟平台自2002年创办以来的全球扩散与远程教学使用情况。
excerpt: Since its launch, PhET’s simulations, which number over 100, have been translated into 90 languages and used in more than 200 countries and territories.
limitation: 聚焦 PhET 这一代表性 STEM 在线交互模拟平台，未涵盖全部商业/科研级网络仿真软件，且2020年数据反映的是疫情初期节点。

coverage: Li & Liang (2024) 发表于 PLOS ONE 的同行评审元分析，整合22篇文献中的46项对照/前后测实验，评估网络虚拟实验室在工程教育中的普及度、学习成效与局限。
excerpt: With the development of network and simulation technology, virtual laboratories have been widely popularized in engineering education. The results show that virtual labs currently lack the ability to completely replace hands-on labs in engineering education.
limitation: 研究对象限定于工程教育领域的46项实验，效应量存在异质性，且明确指出虚拟实验尚无法完全替代实体动手实验。

coverage: Burkett & Smith (2016) 发表于《Electronic Journal of Science Education》的同行评审综述立场论文（ERIC EJ1188061），比较模拟实验室与传统动手实验室在中学科学教育中的定位与边界。
excerpt: However, researchers have not measured simulated laboratory effectiveness for all standard education laboratory goals. Simulated laboratory technology will be part of science education, but how to introduce laboratory simulations and the appropriate role for simulated laboratories remains a subject of debate.
limitation: 为2016年发表的立场综述摘要，未包含近十年新型云端/VR交互仿真的最新实证数据。

coverage: University of Colorado Boulder PhET Interactive Simulations 官方介绍页，涵盖 HTML5 交互式科学/数学模拟的学科覆盖、开放免费机制、课堂测试评估与交互设计原则（奖项列至 2019 年）。
excerpt: PhET provides fun, free, interactive, research-based science and mathematics simulations. ... To help students engage in science and mathematics through inquiry, PhET simulations are developed using the following design principles: Encourage scientific inquiry; Provide interactivity; Make the invisible visible; Show visual mental models; Include multiple representations.
limitation: 该页面为项目官方介绍页，无明确发布日期元数据，且不提供独立第三方的长期宏观入学率或兴趣追踪统计。

coverage: Banda & Nzabahimana (2022) 发表在 Journal of Science Education and Technology (32(1):127–141) 的准实验研究，样本为马拉维布兰太尔 4 所中学的 280 名中学生（女生占 44.6%），评估 PhET 交互式模拟教学对物理学习动机与学业成绩的影响。
excerpt: The ANCOVA test on motivation constructs showed a significant difference with a small effect size between the study groups on self-efficacy, active learning strategies, performance goals, achievement goals, learning environment stimulation, and attitudes towards learning with computer learning.
limitation: 样本局限于马拉维 4 所城市中学的单个物理主题（振动与波），且动机维度的效应量较小（small effect size），不能单独外推为所有地区和学科的长期科学兴趣普及。

coverage: Rutten, van Joolingen, & van der Veen (2012) 发表在 Computers & Education (Vol. 58, Issue 1, pp. 136–153) 的十年科学教育计算机模拟（准）实验研究系统综述。
excerpt: The reviewed literature provides robust evidence that computer simulations can enhance traditional instruction, especially as far as laboratory activities are concerned. However, in most of this research the use of computer simulations has been approached without consideration of the possible impact of teacher support, the lesson scenario, and the computer simulation’s place within the curriculum.
limitation: 综述覆盖 2001–2011 年左右文献，主要聚焦学习效果与教学整合，未直接量化全国性 STEM 专业报考比例变化。

coverage: 美国国家科学基金会（NSF）国家科学与工程统计中心（NCSES）2023 年官方报告 NSF 23-315《Diversity and STEM: Women, Minorities, and Persons with Disabilities 2023》执行摘要，统计截至 2020–2021 年美国 STEM 学位与劳动力群体构成。
excerpt: The U.S. STEM workforce gradually diversified between 2011 and 2021, with increased representation of women and underrepresented minorities. ... Hispanic, Black, and American Indian or Alaska Native persons collectively account for 37% of the U.S. population ages 18–34 years in 2021 and 26% of S&E bachelor’s, 24% of S&E master’s, and 16% of S&E doctoral degrees earned by U.S. citizens and permanent residents in 2020.
limitation: 统计口径限于美国国内 S&E 学位与 STEM 劳动力（数据截至 2020–2021 年），属于宏观科学参与广度的代理指标，无法直接孤立计算机模拟的单一因果贡献。

coverage: Makransky et al. (2019) 发表于 PLOS ONE（PMCID: PMC6459525，2019-03-22 录用）的实验研究，记录了虚拟实验室与桌面虚拟现实科学模拟在高校课堂及居家在线学习中的普及趋势与实测效果（N=112 名大学生物学学生）。
excerpt: The use of virtual laboratories is growing as companies and educational institutions try to expand their reach, cut costs, increase student understanding, and provide more accessible hands on training for future scientists. ... In conclusion, the results indicate that virtual simulations are learning activities that students can engage in just as effectively outside of the classroom environment.
limitation: 实验样本为 112 名具备联网设备的大学生物学学生，未覆盖低龄学童、残障学生或无联网设备群体。

coverage: 联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）与国际电信联盟（ITU）2020 年联合报告《How many children and young people have internet access at home?》，评估全球 25 岁及以下儿童与青年（含 3–17 岁学龄儿童）的家庭互联网接入情况及地区、城乡、收入差距。
excerpt: Globally, 2.2 billion children and young people aged 25 years or less – two-thirds of children and young people worldwide – do not have an internet connection at home. More than two-thirds of school-age girls and boys aged approximately 3 to 17 years (1.3 billion children) ... lack internet access at home.
limitation: 统计时点为 2020 年，仅衡量家庭互联网接入而非学校机房接入，且未单独区分交互式可视化软件的普及率，但家庭联网率是学生能否普遍在线交互获取信息的核心前置门槛。

coverage: 2020-08-18 to 2021-07-27 (release, VR update, console launch, and 2020-2021 awards of Microsoft Flight Simulator)
excerpt: Flight Simulator simulates the topography of the Earth using data from Bing Maps. Microsoft Azure's artificial intelligence (AI) generates the three-dimensional representations of Earth's features, using its cloud computing to render and enhance visuals, and real-world data to generate real-time weather and effects.
limitation: 维基百科条目属于二手汇总来源，且仅代表飞行模拟这一细分标杆作品的技术演进，同时条目也指出该作存在加载缓慢、部分建筑渲染失真及气动模型不够真实等批评。

coverage: K-16 digital games and learning meta-analysis (Clark et al., 2016, Review of Educational Research; k=57 media comparisons, k=20 value-added comparisons)
excerpt: Results from media comparisons indicated that digital games significantly enhanced student learning relative to nongame conditions ( g ¯ = 0.33, 95% confidence interval [0.19, 0.48], k = 57, n = 209). Results from value-added comparisons indicated significant learning benefits associated with augmented game designs ( g ¯ = 0.34, 95% confidence interval [0.17, 0.51], k = 20, n = 40).
limitation: 该元分析涵盖广义 K-16 教育数字游戏（包含模拟游戏但不限于纯商业模拟类），且发表于 2016 年，未覆盖 2016 年之后的最新作品；同时明确指出学习效果受游戏机制、视觉叙事及研究质量调节。

coverage: Randomized controlled experimental study of high-fidelity simulation game vs low-fidelity cases in medical students (N=61, 4-week period)
excerpt: Acquired cognitive skills did not differ between groups. The game group experienced higher intrinsic and germane cognitive load than the cases group ( p = 0.03 and 0.01) and felt more engaged ( p < 0.001).
limitation: 该研究为单一医学急救培训场景下的小样本随机对照实验（N=61），不能代表所有类型模拟游戏的总体水平，但直接证明高逼真度模拟游戏在教育场景中存在认知负荷与分心边界。

coverage: 2020 to 2026-09 case report of Carroll Community College Virtual Reality (VR) Lab published in Community College Journal (AACC)
excerpt: Through a thoughtful, multi-year approach, that goal has evolved into a robust VR lab that supports instruction across disciplines while demonstrating that community colleges can successfully launch and scale VR without significant upfront investment.
limitation: 该报道为单所社区学院的成功案例（依托联邦 HEERF 资金逐步扩展），不能直接推算全美或全球中小学拥有专门 VR 教室的普及比例。

coverage: Large-scale VR deployment of 500 Meta Quest 2 headsets across a dozen K-12 schools in Illinois, California, and Texas (published 2026-04, AECT)
excerpt: This report addresses this gap by documenting a large-scale VR implementation across a dozen K-12 schools in Illinois, California, and Texas. We outline key steps, challenges, and lessons learned during the deployment of 500 Meta Quest 2 headsets and provide actionable recommendations for schools, administrators, and researchers interested in adopting VR.
limitation: 该文献页面提供的是同行评审论文摘要，且明确指出既往研究多集中于高校、小样本与一次性干预，K-12 大规模落地仍存在显著实施挑战。

coverage: Critical literature review of 33 English-language studies on VR and classroom engagement from 2014 to 2023 (Frontiers in Psychology)
excerpt: However, introducing VR into middle school education poses several challenges, including difficulties in the education system to keep up with VR developments, increased demands on students’ digital literacy, and insufficient proficiency of teachers in using VR.
limitation: 该综述覆盖 2014–2023 年 33 篇英文文献，主要聚焦课堂参与度与教学挑战，未给出全球学校 VR 教室硬件拥有率的精确普查百分比。

coverage: Large-scale survey (N = 20,876) on teachers' attitudes, VR integration level, and frequency of VR use in classrooms
excerpt: Overall, teachers had moderately positive perceptions of the use of VR in education. There was no strong correlation between instructional approaches and the level of VR integration, but lower levels of VR integration were associated with more traditional teaching approaches.
limitation: 该大规模调查（N=20,876）发表于 2022 年 11 月，侧重教师态度、整合度与使用频率的关系，未直接报告专门 VR 教室的硬件普及率。

coverage: OECD PISA 2000-2018 across 37 countries (n=1,049,784 15- and 16-year-old students) measuring school loneliness and links to smartphone access and internet use
excerpt: School loneliness increased 2012-2018 in 36 out of 37 countries. Worldwide, nearly twice as many adolescents in 2018 (vs. 2012) had elevated levels of school loneliness.
limitation: PubMed abstract of observational multi-level analysis; authors explicitly note causation cannot be proven and measures cover general smartphone/internet access rather than solely classroom educational technology.

coverage: OECD PISA 2000-2022 across 36 countries (n=1,788,128 15- and 16-year-old students) linking school loneliness and academic performance trends to personal electronic devices
excerpt: In most countries, feeling lonely at school increased while academic performance on standardized tests in math, reading, and science declined, particularly between 2012 and 2022.
limitation: PubMed abstract of observational natural-experiment analysis across 36 countries; reflects personal electronic device and leisure use during school hours alongside COVID-19 period impacts in 2022.

coverage: Nationally representative U.S. survey of 1,391 teens ages 13-17 and parents conducted Sept. 18 to Oct. 10, 2024 by Pew Research Center on social media, friendships, and mental health
excerpt: 74% of teens say these platforms make them feel more connected to their friends, and 63% say they give them a place to show off their creative side.
limitation: U.S.-only self-reported survey of teens ages 13-17 focused on social media rather than classroom educational tools; same report also notes 19% say social media hurt their mental health and 48% see mostly negative effects on peers.

coverage: MIT OpenCourseWare official institutional overview describing free global open access to thousands of MIT courses since 2001
excerpt: Since 2001, MIT OpenCourseWare (OCW) has created new opportunities for learners and educators around the world.
limitation: Institutional self-description without a specific publication date on the page; OCW provides open course materials rather than formal credit or certification.

coverage: Coursera official 2024 annual platform report on global registered learners, university/industry partners, and entry-level Professional Certificates
excerpt: 162 million learners worldwide on Coursera, including 20 million new learners. As demand for alternative credentials rose, there were over 3.3 million enrollments in entry-level Professional Certificates this year.
limitation: Platform self-reported statistics from a commercial online learning provider; registered learners and enrollments do not equal verified course completions or job placements.

coverage: ITU Facts and Figures 2024 global internet penetration, offline population, and income-group connectivity divide
excerpt: In 2024 fully 5.5 billion people are online. That represents 68 per cent of the world population, compared with 65 per cent just one year earlier. But the same figure tells us that 2.6 billion people, one-third of the global population, are still offline.
limitation: Measures internet access rather than online course enrollment directly; serves as an infrastructure boundary showing where people cannot yet access online education.

coverage: Inside Higher Ed report on Reich & Ruipérez-Valiente (2019, Science) analyzing all MIT and Harvard edX MOOCs from 2012 to 2018
excerpt: Among all MOOC participants, 3.13 percent completed their courses in 2017-18, down from about 4 percent the two previous years and nearly 6 percent in 2014-15.
limitation: Covers MIT and Harvard courses on edX through 2017-18; does not capture post-2020 online certificate growth or non-edX platforms, and low completion partially reflects casual auditing by unofficial learners.

coverage: 圣路易斯华盛顿大学教学中心关于高校课堂通过视频会议邀请校友与校外专家担任虚拟嘉宾的实践与成本优势

coverage: 美国图书馆协会（ALA）关于《儿童互联网保护法》（CIPA，Public Law 106-554）生效时间、学校与图书馆E-rate资金过滤与安全政策要求及2003年最高法院裁决的制度记录

coverage: 皮尤研究中心2023年秋季全美K-12公立学校教师调查及2024年州级校园智能手机禁令立法动向、学校政策覆盖率与执行难题

coverage: 《哈佛公报》报道哈佛/兰德/布朗大学2024年10月全美公立学校校长调查（发表于JAMA Health Forum）：96.68%公立学校已制定手机政策及政策执行效果争议

excerpt: Postsecondary enrollment in Fall 2023 increased by 476,522 students (2.5 percent) led by four-year institutions (+3.4%), while exclusively distance education rose at four-year (+5.9%) and graduate (+1.9%) levels but declined at two-year (-6.1%) and less-than-two-year (-37.0%) institutions.

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES/IES）2023年秋季公立学前至12年级（PreK-12）在校学生总数官方统计新闻稿

limitation: 页面元数据未标注精确发表日；数据仅覆盖美国25至34岁全职全年就业者且观测期截至2022年，反映的是文凭/学位的经济回报溢价而非学习者主观动机。

coverage: Burning Glass Institute与哈佛商学院“管理未来工作项目”联合研究报告（2024年2月）：企业宣称取消学历要求转向技能导向招聘的实际落地情况

coverage: U.S. adults' adoption of streaming video services vs. cable/satellite TV, April 2025 survey (N=9,397).

coverage: 伍斯特理工学院（WPI）关于240余名玩家与550余款在线游戏的网络延迟感知与容忍度调查论文摘要页（Jiang, Claypool et al.）。

limitation: 该页面仅提供学术论文摘要，未标明具体发表年份与样本采集年份，且基于玩家自报问卷而非服务器客观遥测。

coverage: 伍斯特理工学院（WPI）Mark Claypool与Kajal Claypool关于网络延迟对不同类型在线游戏玩法退化影响的学术论文摘要页。

excerpt: The camera can be used for video chat, personalized gamer pictures, in-game video chat, and still pictures.
limitation: 维基百科二手条目，无固定发表日；说明主机端游戏内视频聊天早在2006年即已商品化，但属于需另购摄像头的选配功能。

coverage: 任天堂2025年6月5日随Nintendo Switch 2推出的内置语音与视频聊天应用GameChat，支持连接摄像头在游玩时视频通话，并对16岁以下用户要求家长审批摄像头权限。
excerpt: Video chat: GameChat allows for video chat using a supported webcam, like the Nintendo Switch 2 Camera.
limitation: 维基百科二手条目，无固定发表日；记录了2025年6月5日发布的官方系统级游戏视频聊天及权限控制机制，但不提供具体视频开启率统计。

coverage: GamesIndustry.biz报道反诽谤联盟（ADL）与Newzoo联合调查：过去六个月内86%的18-45岁美国在线游戏玩家遭遇骚扰，反映公开多人游戏中的隐私与安全摩擦。
excerpt: The report is based on an ADL survey conducted in collaboration with data analytics firm Newzoo that found that 86% of adults aged 18-45 playing online games had experienced harassment in the past six months.
limitation: 样本限于美国玩家且统计的是广义在线游戏骚扰而非直接统计摄像头关闭率，但作为反面/边界证据说明玩家在陌生人多人局中普遍因隐私与骚扰顾虑不愿开放实景视频。

coverage: 全球最大在线桥牌平台Bridge Base Online（BBO）的用户规模（2024年9月月访问量1160万）、世界大赛高手Vugraph直播观战、教学牌桌与Bridge Master教学工具，以及2026年8月分级会员付费墙边界
excerpt: Bridge Base Online (BBO) has about 11.6 million monthly visits as of September 2024, offers Vugraph live broadcasts with expert commentary and Teaching Tables/Bridge Master, and introduced three membership tiers on August 19, 2026 limiting free users to six boards a day.
limitation: 维基百科词条为持续更新的二手综合百科页面，无单一固定发表日；所涉最新事实观测截至2026年8月19日，且主要覆盖在线桥牌领域。

coverage: 全球主流游戏与电竞直播平台Twitch的观战规模（2015年月观众超1亿、2020年2月日活1500万与月主播300万、2025年1月全球访问量第30名网站）
excerpt: Twitch is a video live-streaming service popular in video games and esports competitions, reaching 15 million daily active users, 3 million monthly broadcasters, and 1.4 million average concurrent users as of February 2020, and ranking as the 30th-most-visited website worldwide as of January 2025.
limitation: 维基百科词条无单一固定发表日；流量统计同时包含非游戏内容（如音乐与IRL直播），但核心业务仍以游戏与电竞观战为主。

coverage: Chess.com官方人类国际象棋教练目录，展示拥有大师头衔的真人高手提供在线一对一/小组授课与对局复盘指导（多为商业收费模式）
excerpt: Titled human chess coaches actively offer full-time online coaching, lessons, and training games with analysis on Chess.com's official coaches directory.
limitation: 为实时更新的商业教练目录页面，页面元数据无明确发表日期；仅反映国际象棋在线找高手拜师学艺的供给与商业化模式，不代表所有游戏品类均免费。

coverage: 在线游戏直播观战中的“窥屏狙击（Stream sniping）”竞技公平与隐私边界问题，迫使《Rust》《Fortnite》隐藏知名主播ID及主播采取遮挡地图、设置直播延迟等反制措施
excerpt: Stream sniping is a common tactic to gain an advantage by watching an enemy player's live stream, prompting games such as Rust and Fortnite to hide popular streamers' names and streamers to cover in-game maps or add stream delays.
limitation: 维基百科词条无单一固定发表日，窥屏狙击段落所引具体案例截至2018年11月；主要构成实时观战高手时的隐私与防作弊摩擦边界，并未否定在线观战本身的可得性。

coverage: 在线多人虚拟桌游沙盒平台Tabletop Simulator（2015年6月发布），支持最多10名玩家在线围坐虚拟游戏桌游玩国际象棋、跳棋、扑克及Steam创意工坊3000余款自定义桌游与环境
excerpt: Tabletop Simulator (released June 2015) is a multiplayer physics sandbox supporting up to ten online players around customizable virtual tables for chess, checkers, poker, and over 3,000 community-shared board games and custom assets on Steam Workshop.
limitation: 维基百科词条无单一固定发表日，正文主要记录2014-2015年发布与核心玩法；反映的是PC/桌面端虚拟游戏桌生态，不包含平台最新活跃玩家数。

coverage: 社交虚拟世界平台VRChat（2014年发布、2017年上线Steam、2018年上线Quest、2025年10月24日全面登陆App Store与Google Play），允许用户通过3D虚拟化身在用户自建的社交空间、演出场馆与游戏世界中相聚互动
excerpt: VRChat allows users to interact with others using 3D avatars in user-developed worlds taking the form of social spaces, performance venues, and games across VR headsets, desktop PC, and mobile devices (fully released on App Store and Google Play on October 24, 2025).
limitation: 维基百科词条无单一固定发表日，正文记录截至2025年10月24日；同时指出桌面模式在肢体自由移动和双手交互上存在局限。

coverage: Roblox公司2025年第二季度官方财报新闻稿（2025年7月31日发布，数据截至2025年6月30日），披露该全球共享虚拟体验平台平均日活跃用户（DAU）达1.118亿、季度参与时长达274亿小时
excerpt: Roblox Corporation reported Q2 2025 Average Daily Active Users (DAUs) of 111.8 million (up 41% YoY) and 27.4 billion hours engaged (up 58% YoY) across its global platform of shared virtual experiences.
limitation: 为上市公司官方季度财报新闻稿，证明虚构/定制3D社交虚拟世界与探索类多人游戏已达亿级日常规模，但不单独拆解“真实地点数字化重现”的占比。

coverage: GamesIndustry.biz援引《华尔街日报》对Meta内部文件的报道（2022年10月17日），披露旗舰VR社交世界Horizon Worlds月活不足20万、首月后多数用户流失、仅9%用户自建世界访问量超50人、超50% Quest头显购入6个月后闲置
excerpt: Internal Meta documents reported by WSJ show Horizon Worlds fell below 200,000 MAUs (vs 500,000 target), most users did not return after the first month, only 9% of community-built worlds ever reached 50+ visitors, and over 50% of Quest headsets were unused six months after purchase.
limitation: 报道时间为2022年10月17日，聚焦Meta基于VR头显的Horizon Worlds，反映的是沉浸式VR头显社交相聚的主流留存瓶颈，而非否定屏幕端或整体在线虚拟世界与桌游平台的存在。

coverage: 全球最大PC游戏数字发行与联机平台Steam在2026年10月创下43,505,724同时在线用户及1450万同时在游戏中玩家的历史纪录，并对比Roblox与Fortnite的在线玩家规模。
excerpt: Steam has once again broken its all-time record for concurrent users, reaching an utterly extraordinary 43,505,724 people logged in at the same time. However, SteamDB records that 14.5 million actually were in-game when the record was broken.
limitation: 媒体转引SteamDB监测数据；登录并发数包含后台挂机未游玩账户，且仅反映Steam单一PC平台（另附Roblox与Fortnite对比），不等于全球全部在线电脑游戏玩家总数。

coverage: 美国娱乐软件协会（ESA）《2025年美国电子游戏产业基本事实》官方报告，统计205.1百万美国定期玩家、89%玩家在线游玩比例、2024年593亿美元消费支出，以及各平台渗透率（移动端82%、主机47%、PC 45%）。
excerpt: 205.1 million Americans now play video games regularly. 89% of total players (ages 8-90) have played video games online (alone or with others). Video Game Platforms Played Among Individual Gamers (Among total players 8+): Mobile 82%, Console 47%, PC 45%.
limitation: 仅覆盖美国市场抽样调查（YouGov）与Circana美国消费支出，不能直接等同全球比例；且89%在线游玩涵盖所有设备（手机、主机、PC），同时显示移动端渗透率（82%）已显著高于传统PC（45%）。

coverage: 在线游戏跨PC、主机与移动端普及概况（2019年细分营收169亿美元），以及在线游戏依赖专用服务器导致无法永久可玩的边界限制。
excerpt: Online games are ubiquitous on modern gaming platforms, including PCs, consoles and mobile devices, and span many genres, including first-person shooters, strategy games, massively multiplayer online role-playing games (MMORPG), and racing simulators. Unlike purchased retail games, online games have the problem of not being permanently playable, as they require special servers in order to function.
limitation: 维基百科二手综述条目，文内营收数据截至2019年较早期，仅作为行业普及背景与在线模式服务器依赖边界的佐证。

coverage: 大型多人在线角色扮演游戏（MMORPG）作为依托持续在线世界诞生的新游戏类型的定义及其商业普及规模（如《魔兽世界》2014年超1000万订阅、年营收10.4亿美元）。
excerpt: MMORPGs are distinguished from single-player or small multi-player online RPGs by the number of players able to interact together, and by the game's persistent world (usually hosted by the game's publisher), which continues to exist and evolve while the player is offline and away from the game.
limitation: 维基百科二手综述条目，引用的订阅与营收统计主要集中在2005–2014年MMORPG鼎盛期，且该类型在机制上融合了既有RPG与大型在线元素。

coverage: 大逃杀（Battle Royale）作为大型在线多人新游戏类型的核心玩法、起源（2010年代初在线生存游戏模组）及PUBG/Fortnite等2017–2020年爆发普及记录。
excerpt: A battle royale game is an online multiplayer video game genre that blends last-man-standing gameplay with the survival, exploration, and scavenging elements of a survival game. The genre's origins arose from mods for large-scale online survival games like Minecraft and Arma 2 in the early 2010s.
limitation: 维基百科二手综述条目；同时表明大逃杀类型是从既有生存游戏在线模组演化而来，而非完全脱离旧玩法凭空创造。

coverage: Valve主办的Dota 2年度全球锦标赛The International（2011年创办），通过游戏内众筹使2021年单届赛事奖金池达到4000万美元的历史最高纪录。
excerpt: The International (TI) is an annual esports world championship for the five-on-five video game Dota 2. Internationals have the largest single-tournament prize pool of any esport event, with its largest reaching US$40 million in 2021.
limitation: 维基百科二手综述条目，反映单项顶级赛事峰值规模；未展开说明2022年后Valve调整众筹策略导致奖金池大幅回落的后续波动。

coverage: 电竞世界杯（Esports World Cup）作为覆盖超过25款游戏的年度国际大型电竞赛事，总奖金池超过7000万美元（2025年汇聚100个国家2500余名参赛者）。
excerpt: It is considered the largest professional esports event in the world in terms of total prize pool and number of game titles represented, with upwards of US$70 million awarded across individual tournament prize pools, rewards for teams that qualify to events, most valuable player awards, and the Club Championship.
limitation: 维基百科二手综述条目；高额奖金高度依赖特定主办方与主权/机构资金投入，不代表全球所有在线游戏竞赛均具备同等商业回报。

coverage: 暴雪《守望先锋联赛》（OWL，2018–2023）作为高额特许经营制职业电竞赛事，因财务可行性危机与赞助撤出在2023年11月宣告结束并转型，构成电竞商业化可持续性的反面/边界案例。
excerpt: By November 2023, Blizzard had announced that Overwatch esports was "transitioning" from the Overwatch League into a more traditional esports structure for the title, which would become the Overwatch Champions Series (OWCS) in 2024.
limitation: 维基百科二手综述条目；OWL的终止仅说明高额特许经营制商业模式失败，其赛事本身仍转为OWCS继续举办，并未否定“存在颁发奖品的在线游戏竞赛”这一事实。

coverage: Xbox Wire official press release on Microsoft Xbox Live's 'Game with Fame' program (2004-2005) enabling everyday gamers to play online directly against celebrities from stage, screen, and sports.
excerpt: For the past year, gamers around the world have enjoyed playing on Xbox Live” against some of the biggest stars of stage, screen and sports in “Game with Fame” events.
limitation: Official Microsoft promotional press release covering Xbox Live console events in 2004-2005; reflects scheduled promotional sessions rather than unrestricted continuous celebrity availability.

coverage: Chess.com official coverage of the PogChamps 6 7 celebrity online chess tournament (April 2026), documenting over 200,000 concurrent viewers watching celebrities play online.
excerpt: Over 200,000 viewers were concurrently tuned into the PogChamps 6 7 final, showing that demand for celebrity chess shenanigans is stronger than ever.
limitation: Platform-published event report focused on internet celebrities and Twitch streamers playing online chess on Chess.com; demonstrates mass online spectating rather than open viewer sign-up to play.

coverage: Rock Paper Shotgun report on British chess Grandmaster Simon Williams playing live online chess games on Twitch against 500 to 600 viewers.
excerpt: When the creators of Pure Chess [ official site ] decided to promote their new game by pitting the chat stream of Twitch against British grandmaster Simon Williams
limitation: Covers a single promotional Twitch event in September 2016 where viewers played collectively via chat against one grandmaster, also noting potential engine-assistance issues.

coverage: Business Insider explainer on stream sniping in online gaming, detailing how games hide matchmaking information and Twitch provides broadcast delays to prevent viewers from unfairly joining streamers' public matches.
excerpt: Some games, like "Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War," have measures to try and prevent stream snipers from being in the same games as streamers in the first place by hiding information about game matchmaking.
limitation: Secondary technology news explainer; illustrates structural anti-harassment and anti-cheating friction that restricts open public matchmaking against celebrities/streamers, though it does not rule out organized fan matches.

coverage: Wikipedia article on ABC's 2014 interactive TV competition 'Rising Star', documenting real-time viewer voting via mobile app with immediate on-screen results ('The Wall') as well as time-zone constraints and cancellation after one season due to low ratings.

limitation: Encyclopedia secondary summary (last revised 2026-11-23) covering a 2014 U.S. broadcast singing competition; prizes went to studio contestants rather than home viewers, and the show was cancelled after one season.

coverage: Wikipedia article on Microsoft's Xbox Live interactive game show adaptation '1 vs. 100' (2009-2010), documenting live mass-multiplayer trivia participation, real-time leaderboards, and prizes awarded to home players, as well as cancellation after two seasons.

The top three players in The Crowd win the XBLA game as well.
limitation: Encyclopedia secondary summary (last revised 2026-11-17) describing a 2009-2010 Xbox 360 console adaptation of a TV game show rather than a native cable/broadcast television set-top system.

coverage: Kotaku report on Microsoft cancelling the Xbox Live interactive game show '1 vs. 100' in July 2010 because direct advertising revenue failed to cover the cost of producing new seasons.
excerpt: In the end, we’re told, Microsoft killed the online game because the direct revenue it was bringing in wasn’t enough to cover the costs of creating new seasons.
limitation: Gaming journalism report citing anonymous sources close to the project regarding commercial and management reasons for the 2010 cancellation.

coverage: Xbox Live Primetime实时互动电视益智节目《1 vs. 100》（2009–2010年）追踪常驻玩家周/轮/赛季积分并发放奖励，以及两季后停播的边界记录
excerpt: 1 vs. 100 Live was hosted live for Xbox Live Gold subscribers; player selection was based on weekly, round, and season (lifetime) score, awarding up to 10,000 Microsoft Points and Xbox Live Arcade games, before Microsoft confirmed on July 15, 2010 it would not return for a third season.
limitation: 维基百科条目属于二手百科汇编，且该节目仅在Xbox 360平台运行两季（2009–2010年）即停播，说明实时互动奖品节目在商业可持续性上存在局限。

coverage: CBS News报道互动直播问答节目HQ Trivia每日实时播出并向参与答题的在线观众发放真实现金奖励（2018年1月）
excerpt: At least 1.6 million people opened the HQ Trivia smartphone app for a live hosted quiz show with $15,000 in real prize money up for grabs, turning the quiz show into a participatory event.
limitation: 报道聚焦HQ Trivia爆发初期的用户参与与现金奖池，未直接量化点名常驻观众的比例，且当时仍依赖风险投资补贴奖金。

coverage: CBS New York报道HQ Trivia因热度衰退及投资方撤资而停运解散（2020年2月）
excerpt: The once-popular mobile quiz app HQ Trivia officially shut down as popularity faded and prospective investors pulled the plug on new funding.

coverage: 美国博彩协会（AGA）2025年8月报告，衡量美国合法与非法/离岸在线博彩及体育博彩的庞大规模
excerpt: Americans wager $673.6B annually with illegal/unregulated operators; illegal online slots and table games reached $18.6B in revenue (+38% since 2022), illegal sportsbooks took $84B in wagers, while legal market growth cut illegal sportsbooks' share from 36% to 24%.
limitation: 数据为行业协会对美国市场的估算，未覆盖全球所有司法辖区，但清晰反映互联网对合法与非法赌博均产生了巨大影响。

coverage: Sumsub 2025年全球加密博彩合规报告：数字货币用于在线下注与提现（2024年规模超810亿美元）及受监管市场的法币优先边界
excerpt: Crypto casinos took more than $81 billion in 2024 using virtual assets such as Bitcoin, Ether, or stablecoins to fund or withdraw, while most regulated markets remain fiat-first.
limitation: 属于合规服务商行业研究，同时指出多数强监管持牌市场仍以法币数字支付为主，限制直接使用加密货币。

coverage: 主流持牌在线博彩运营商bet365服务条款（2026年8月31日生效）：通过服务器实时受理网页/App赔率投注，但明文禁止并作废电子邮件下注
excerpt: bet365 only accepts transactions made online (including via mobile app) validated by its servers, and explicitly declares transactions sent by email invalid and void.
limitation: 属于单一头部持牌运营商（新泽西州）的规则条款，代表现代持牌在线体育博彩的通行实务（网页/App实时服务器受理、拒收邮件下注），不能完全排除早期或非正规私庄曾零星使用邮件沟通下注。

coverage: 美国联邦法典第49编第41311条（49 U.S.C. § 41311），规定商业航空公司在涉美国际航空运输中禁止安装、运输、运营或允许使用包括机上电子交互视频赌博应用在内的任何赌博设备。
excerpt: An air carrier or foreign air carrier may not install, transport, or operate, or permit the use of, any gambling device on board an aircraft in foreign air transportation.
limitation: 该条文系美国联邦法律（1994年8月23日增补，持续有效），约束所有涉美航线的美国及外国航空公司，但不直接覆盖完全不经过美国领空或起降的非美航线。

coverage: 国际航空乘客体验协会（APEX）关于航空旅行与机上赌博历史及监管障碍的专题报道，记录了1981年新航、1996-1998年瑞航与IFT合作试点及空难后取消，以及空客、维珍、瑞安航空方案未能落地的经过。
excerpt: Fifteen years later, SwissAir, in conjunction with Las Vegas-based Interactive Flight Technologies, installed an IFE system with a screen-based gambling feature on its long-haul jets. When SwissAir Flight 111 crashed in 1998, investigators found a correlation with the IFE system, and SwissAir abandoned that configuration.
limitation: 该报道发表于2016年8月2日，反映截至2016年商业航空机上赌博的历史试点与监管现状，未涵盖2016年之后高速机上卫星Wi-Fi普及后的新动态。

coverage: 2026年7月关于达美航空与博彩平台DraftKings在机上Delta Sync Wi-Fi推出SkyPicks合作的报道，证实截至2026年机上真钱赌博仍然违法，航司只能推出无投注的免费体育预测游戏。
excerpt: It’s taken a year and a half but they’re finally rolling out ‘sports predictions’ without betting, as a way for DraftKings to sign up Delta flyers for their platforms (where they can gamble later). In this way, Delta monetizes gambling without running afoul of the law.
limitation: 该文为航空业垂直媒体评论报道，主要聚焦美国达美航空与美国联邦法律（Johnson Act等），未逐一统计全球所有非美航司的Wi-Fi内容过滤策略。

coverage: 英国博彩委员会（UKGC）《远程赌博与软件技术标准》RTS 3官方规范，强制要求持牌在线赌博游戏在玩家下注前清晰提供游戏规则及获胜概率信息（包括庄家优势house edge、返还率RTP或中奖概率）。

excerpt: Overall, the findings indicate that in the Snowden case, social media did not provide new forums for those who might otherwise remain silent to express their opinions and debate issues. This suggests a spiral of silence might spill over from online contexts to in-person contexts, though our data cannot definitively demonstrate this causation. limitation: 基于294家服务机器人供应商样本统计，未推算全行业总量，且消费级家用机器人高度集中于扫地、割草等单一专项任务。

coverage: Computer History Museum retrospective on the 1998 Furby robotic toy, its sensors/motors, language behavior, and 1998-2001 global sales volume.
excerpt: Furby was a robotic “friend” that could respond to touch, light, and sound... During the first three years of production, over 40 million Furbys were sold.
limitation: Retrospective museum blog article summarizing 1998-2001 toy history; Furby was interactive and customizable in appearance/response but was not end-user programmable by children.

coverage: MIT Media Lab institutional record of the 1998 launch of LEGO Mindstorms programmable robotic construction kit for children.
excerpt: In 1998, LEGO launched the Mindstorms construction kit... allowing children to build and program their own robots and other computerized contraptions.
limitation: Institutional overview without exact unit sales figures; does not cover voice-synthesis or favorite-character voice features.

coverage: The Robot Report 35-year history of iRobot, documenting Roomba's early 2000s launch, 1 million sales within just over two years, and >50 million cumulative robots sold.
excerpt: In just over two years, iRobot sold one million Roombas, a milestone most robotics companies haven’t reached today... Since its founding in 1990, iRobot has sold more than 50 million robots worldwide.
limitation: Trade publication retrospective covering one company (iRobot); Roomba launched in 2002 (7 years after 1995), so whether 2002-2004 falls within Gates' qualitative 'soon' depends on window interpretation.

coverage: International Federation of Robotics (IFR) World Robotics 2025 Service Robots press release reporting 2024 global consumer service robot sales (~20 million units) dominated by floor cleaning and lawn mowing.
excerpt: Service robots for consumer use have experienced a solid growth rate of 11% with close to 20 million units sold in 2024. Robots for domestic tasks (floor cleaning, lawn moving etc.) were by far the largest group of consumer robots.
limitation: Press release summary of IFR survey-based statistics for 2024; aggregates domestic tasks without breaking out complex dexterous chores such as cooking or diaper changing separately.

coverage: IFR World Robotics 2026 Service Robots press release reporting 2025 global sales of consumer domestic robots (~34.2 million units) versus full-size humanoid robots (~7,000 units, commercial/professional, often teleoperated).
excerpt: In 2025, about 7,000 units of full-size humanoids (above 140 cm) were sold globally... Overall sales of consumer robots increased by 37% to almost 34.2 million units in 2025.
limitation: Press release summary covering 2025 full-year shipments; full-size humanoid count excludes R&D and entertainment units and focuses on commercial/professional deployments, illustrating the absence of mass-market dexterous home robots.

coverage: IFR Position Paper 'Humanoid Robots – Vision and Reality' press release assessing the gap between vision and practical reality for universal household humanoid helpers.
excerpt: However, mass adoption as universal household helpers may not happen in the near or medium term.
limitation: Industry federation position paper summary representing expert consensus as of August 2025 rather than a household-level task benchmark.

coverage: 2016-2025年美国电力行业按技术类型（AMR、AMI、标准非AMR/AMI电表）与用户部门统计的电表数量（Form EIA-861，Electric Power Annual 2025）
limitation: 仅覆盖美国电力行业（Form EIA-861，不含EIA-861S小微电力公司，亦不含燃气或水表），且反映装表数量而非功能启用率。

coverage: 2016-2025年美国电力需求响应（Demand Response）注册用户数、节电量与峰值负荷削减统计（Form EIA-861，Electric Power Annual 2025）
excerpt: 2025年美国居民部门注册参与需求响应项目的用户数为11,487,568户（约占1.48亿居民电表的7.8%），潜在峰值负荷削减10,586 MW、实际峰值负荷削减4,977 MW。
limitation: 统计的是电力公司申报的需求响应项目注册户数与峰荷削减，未细分分钟级自动直控与时段电价/人工响应比例；2023年年度申报口径调整导致节电量（MWh）序列存在断层。

coverage: 美国EIA关于智能电表（AMI）技术定义、数据采集与回传频率及2021-2022年普及率的官方说明
excerpt: EIA定义AMI电表最低按小时粒度计量并至少每日向电力公司与用户各提供一次数据，涵盖从基础小时计量电表到具备双向通信、可实时记录并传输瞬时数据的电表。
limitation: 该FAQ最后更新于2023年10月20日（覆盖至2022年数据），不涵盖天然气与水表，且未统计实际启用分钟级实时双向调控的家庭比例。

coverage: 国际电信联盟（ITU）《衡量数字发展：2025年事实与数据》全球互联网接入率与离线人口估算
excerpt: 2025年全球近四分之三人口已接入互联网，但增速放缓，仍有22亿人处于离线状态（主要集中在中低收入国家），城乡与性别鸿沟及宽带可负担性差距依然存在。
limitation: 页面为报告摘要，给出全球总体在线比例与离线人数估算，未在该摘要页单列各国细分普及率。

coverage: OpenAQ全球开放空气质量监测平台关于汇聚政府参考级监测站与空气传感器实时/历史数据并向公众开放访问的官方说明
excerpt: OpenAQ自2015年起汇聚各国政府参考级监测站实时与历史数据，2021年起接入低成本空气传感器数据，并在开源开放平台免费向公众、科研人员与社区开放查询。
limitation: 网页未标注明确发表日期；属于环境空气质量公开监测领域的代表性开放平台，不能直接代表全部商业或私有物联网传感器的公开程度。

coverage: 美国地质调查局（USGS）国家水文数据平台使用自动传感器采集并实时公开发布全美水文监测数据的官方门户说明
excerpt: USGS通过自动传感器与人工采集在全国逾百万个监测点持续收集超过135年的水文数据，并提供各州实时连续监测数据的公开查询。
limitation: 网页未标注明确发表日期；仅覆盖美国政府公共水文监测系统，不代表私有或商业传感数据的开放状况。

coverage: 欧盟委员会《数据法案》（Data Act，2024年1月11日生效、2025年9月12日正式适用）关于打破联网设备与物联网数据封闭、规范数据共享与保密及个人数据保护的政策说明
excerpt: 欧盟《数据法案》于2024年1月11日生效、2025年9月12日正式适用，旨在赋予用户对汽车、智能电视和工业机械等联网设备所生成数据的控制权，禁止阻碍数据共享的不公平合同，同时确保个人数据保护与数据保密性。
limitation: 网页未标注明确发表日期，且为欧盟监管政策文本，反映联网设备/物联网数据长期由制造商封闭控制及受隐私保密约束的制度事实，而非全球公开率定量统计。

coverage: 全球公共场所实时网络摄像头流媒体平台（EarthCam，1996年至今）
excerpt: EarthCam.com , the global network of owned and operated live streaming webcams, was built as a way to transport people to interesting and unique locations around the world that may be difficult or impossible to experience in person.
limitation: 企业官网自我介绍，未提供网页发表日期元数据，且主要覆盖旅游地标、城市景观及企业/政府项目摄像头，并非覆盖所有公共场所。

coverage: 美国官方抵押贷款基准利率在线发布（房地美 Primary Mortgage Market Survey，每周更新至2026年11月）
excerpt: The PMMS results are based on data from our Loan Product Advisor (LPA): mortgage rates collected from thousands of loan applications submitted to Freddie Mac from lenders across the country when a borrower applies for a mortgage.
limitation: 网页本身为动态滚动更新页，未标注单一静态发表日期元数据；PMMS为每周四发布的全国均价而非逐秒报价，且仅限美国常规单户住宅抵押贷款口径。

coverage: 在线体育赛事滚球/实时赔率数据服务（Sportradar Live Odds，涵盖NBA、NHL、UEFA等数千场赛事）
excerpt: Take your sportsbook in-play with confidence Get the most up-to-date odds on your site, overseen by our traders in real time for maximum confidence.
limitation: 属于体育博彩数据供应商商业产品页，仅证明在线实时体育博彩赔率已大规模工业化提供，不涵盖各国博彩合法性限制与彩票开奖业务。

coverage: 联网智能自动售货机实时库存、销售与故障远程遥测汇报（Vending on Track）
excerpt: A smart vending machine is a vending machine that is connected to the internet and reports what it is doing. It takes cashless payment, sends every sale, stock level and fault to a cloud dashboard in real time, and can be managed remotely — prices, planograms, access rules and alerts — without a visit.
limitation: 属于行业方案商技术说明页且无发表日期元数据；同时反映出现实边界——现代售货机遥测主要面向运营商云端后台（B2B管理与访问控制），而非向所有公众开放查询。

coverage: 全渠道零售网站实时商品库存查询功能及其账实偏差局限（Kibo Commerce，2023-07-21）
excerpt: Here’s a common consumer shopping experience: A retailer’s website shows they have an artisanal coffee maker in stock, but when the customer stops by the store to buy it, they discover it’s sold out.
limitation: 属于电商软件厂商行业分析文章；既证明零售网站已普遍向消费者提供在线库存查询，也作为反面/边界证据指出线上显示有货但线下售罄的库存同步偏差仍常见。

coverage: Realtor.com 推出 Street Peek 手机增强现实（AR）实景叠加房源信息功能（2017-08-28）
excerpt: Today, realtor.com ® launched Street Peek, which uses the location and orientation of the user combined with a proprietary algorithm to allow smartphone users to point their Android device at homes, and instantaneously surface property details about homes in the realtor.com ® database.
limitation: 企业官方发布稿；该功能依赖用户本人携带智能手机亲临街区现场拍摄（on-site camera），而非远程从城市各处调取实时画面，且主要覆盖美国房源数据库。

coverage: 美国全国房地产经纪人协会（NAR）报道手机AR实景摄像头叠加房源挂牌价与状态气泡（2019-02-25）
excerpt: For home shopping: Pan your phone around a neighborhood to view popups of listing price information, sold dates, estimated values, and more through realtor.com®’s Street Peek app. It uses AR to reveal information bubbles over properties users are viewing.
limitation: 行业协会报道，说明AR摄像头叠加挂牌价格信息在移动购房场景中已实现，但同样依赖用户现场举起手机扫描街区，并非远程调取城市公共实时视频流。

coverage: 爱尔兰数据保护委员会（DPC）关于 Google Street View 非实时图像与隐私模糊延迟的官方说明
excerpt: Where images are captured by Street View cameras, there is typically a time delay before images are published on the internet; therefore the image available through Street View is not a 'real time' image. This delay allows for Google to deploy blurring technology to faces and car registration plates.
limitation: 为爱尔兰官方监管机构FAQ页面，未标注具体发表日期元数据；仅针对Google Street View机制，但直接证明主流远程城市街景服务受隐私与处理流程限制并非实时画面。

coverage: Google Street View 官方采集机制说明：由采集车与贡献者周期性拍摄360度全景照片并自动模糊人脸与车牌
excerpt: Google-owned content credits “Street View” or “Google Maps.” We automatically blur faces and license plates in our imagery.
limitation: 为Google官方产品说明页，未标注单一发表日期元数据；说明远程城市街景的底层数据源为定期拍摄的静态全景照片，而非持续在线的城市实时视频流。

coverage: 美国联邦选举委员会（FEC）官方个人竞选捐款公开检索门户（支持按州、邮编及个人姓名在线检索与浏览）
excerpt: FEC official portal allows the public to search elections by state or ZIP code and look up federal campaign contributions from specific individuals online.
limitation: 官方实时数据门户页面未标注固定发表日期；仅覆盖依法须向FEC申报的联邦竞选捐款，不含未披露捐助人的501(c)(4)暗钱支出。

coverage: 皮尤研究中心（Pew Research Center）对美国犯罪统计数据在线获取渠道（FBI Crime Data Explorer与BJS工具）及执法机构上报缺口的分析
excerpt: Public crime statistics are accessible online via the FBI Crime Data Explorer and BJS NCVS tool, though FBI data covers reported crimes and in 2022 received data from 83% of participating agencies.
limitation: 该文引用的最新完整年度FBI统计截至2022年；同时体现支持（FBI Crime Data Explorer在线公开查询）与边界（未报案犯罪及部分警局未参与上报）。

coverage: 美国联邦政府官方开放数据门户Data.gov关于联邦机构编制并发布公开或潜在公开数据清单（Public Data Listing）的制度说明
excerpt: Federal agencies are required to catalog their data assets and publish a Public Data Listing of assets that are public or could be made public via data.json and Data.gov.
limitation: 机构介绍页未标注精确发表日；反映联邦层面开放数据目录制度，但不能代表所有潜在公开记录均可无需审批即时获取。

coverage: 佛罗里达大学Brechner信息自由中心援引美国司法部信息政策办公室2024财年FOIA年度报告，统计联邦信息公开申请积压、耗时与完全批准率
excerpt: DOJ FY 2024 FOIA report shows federal requests surged 25% to 1.5 million, backlogged requests rose 33% to 267,056, simple request response times rose to 44 days, and fully granted requests fell to an all-time low of 12%.
limitation: 聚焦美国联邦层面的信息自由法（FOIA）申请记录，反映尚未主动开放上网的潜在公开政府信息在现实中的获取壁垒，观察期截至2024财年末（2024-09-30）。

coverage: Pinterest, Inc. 2026年第三季度Form 10-Q官方SEC季报（截至2026年9月30日），披露视觉搜索与图像浏览平台的全球月活跃用户规模
excerpt: Pinterest is a visual search and discovery platform reaching 661 million monthly active users as of September 30, 2026, up 10% year-over-year.
limitation: 单一上市平台的一手财务与运营披露，代表互联网大众图像浏览需求的核心样本之一，但以广告变现而非用户直接付费浏览为主。

coverage: Getty Images Holdings, Inc. 2026年第三季度Form 10-Q官方SEC季报（截至2026年9月30日），披露全球视觉内容在线市场及付费下载量变化
excerpt: Getty Images serves global customers via Getty Images, iStock, and Unsplash websites/APIs, recording 87 million paid downloads in LTM ended September 30, 2026 (down from 93 million in LTM ended September 30, 2025, partially offset by Unsplash growth).
limitation: 既证实全球在线高质量图像授权与下载已形成数千万级年付费需求，也揭示传统付费创意图库近期面临下载量同比下滑（9300万降至8700万）的结构性竞争边界。

coverage: 英国摄影杂志（1854 Photography / BJP）报道比尔·盖茨旗下Corbis于2016年1月出售图像业务及其家庭数字艺术展示愿景未能实现的商业复盘
excerpt: Gates founded Corbis in 1989 believing consumers would decorate homes with revolving digital displays of art, but that vision did not bear out; Corbis cut 15% of staff in Nov 2015 and sold its image division to Visual China Group (with Getty Images distributing globally outside China) in Jan 2016.
limitation: 主要针对比尔·盖茨个人创立的Corbis及家庭付费数字艺术展示这一特定商业路径的受挫，不否定互联网整体高质量图像需求与大众图像浏览的普及。

coverage: 美国国家艺术基金会（NEA）2022年全美公众艺术参与调查（SPPA）官方核心报告，涵盖40,718名美国18岁以上成年人在2017—2022年间的电子/数字媒体艺术消费、艺术摄影与视觉/平面艺术创作及艺术博物馆/画廊线下参观率。
excerpt: 75%的美国成年人通过电子或数字媒体消费艺术；2022年13.3%从事艺术摄影、10.7%创作含平面设计与数字艺术在内的其他视觉艺术；但2017至2022年间通过设备浏览艺术的比例从16.0%降至11.1%，参观艺术博物馆或画廊的比例从23.7%降至17.7%。
limitation: 仅覆盖美国成年人样本，且2022年数据仍受新冠疫情余波影响；报告版权页仅标注发表年月为October 2023，无精确发表日。

coverage: Ateca-Amestoy 与 Castiglione 发表在《Journal of Cultural Economics》的同行评审实证研究，基于美国2012年SPPA数据联合分析视觉艺术的现场博物馆参观与手持/互联网数字参与之间的关系。
excerpt: 参观博物馆和艺术画廊与通过手持设备及互联网进行数字视觉艺术访问呈正相关，但反过来互联网访问对线下博物馆参观并未发现同样的正向关联；对许多受时间与成本约束的消费者而言，线上参与与线下参观存在权衡关系。
limitation: 实证数据来自美国2012年SPPA截面调查，反映的是智能手机普及初期至中期格局，未涵盖近年新平台变化。

coverage: 荷兰国立博物馆（Rijksmuseum）数字部门负责人 Peter Gorgels 在 Museums and the Web 2013 发表的官方项目论文，介绍开放图像数据库 Rijksstudio 的上线与公众交互机制。
excerpt: Rijksstudio 免费向全球公众开放 125,000 件藏品的高分辨率数字图像，支持深度缩放、下载、收藏到个人工作室、分享与无版权限制的平面及创意再创作。
limitation: 该论文主要为单个旗舰博物馆数字化项目的机构报告与上线早期描述，未提供全社会层面的兴趣增长对照统计，且会议论文页面仅标明年份 2013。

coverage: CultureCase 对 Yves Evrard 与 Anne Krebs（2018，《Journal of Cultural Economics》）卢浮宫线上与线下观众对比研究（样本量逾6,000人）的学术摘要。
excerpt: 69%的受访者既访问卢浮宫网站又实地参观，人们普遍不以线上参观替代实地到访，所有群体一致高度认同原作真实性的主导价值；但博物馆网站触达的社会经济群体与线下观众并无实质差异。
limitation: 属于对单个世界顶级博物馆（卢浮宫）研究的二次学术摘要，网页元数据日期（3 December 2013）与正文所涉2015年数据及2018年原论文发表年份存在错配，且研究对象集中于卢浮宫受众。

coverage: 宾夕法尼亚大学神经美学中心等团队发表在《Scientific Reports》（2025）的两项实证实验，直接对比观众在博物馆面对原作与通过数字屏幕看艺术复制品的审美体验、情感冲击与理解深度。
excerpt: 观众在博物馆面对原作时报告获得了比在实验室屏幕上看数字媒介更深的理解；但在审美评价、认知情感冲击与一周后的记忆留存方面，博物馆与数字媒介之间并无显著差异。
limitation: 实验基于费城两家机构（Barnes Foundation 与 Penn Museum）的受控样本，主要测量单次接触后的心理与审美反应，未直接测量长期参观频率变化。

coverage: 《The Art Newspaper》2026年3月31日发布的2025年全球前100名艺术博物馆年度参观人次统计调查。
excerpt: 2025年全球前100名艺术博物馆总参观人次超过2亿，较2020年疫情低谷（5,400万）大幅回升且总体保持高人气，但仍低于2019年的2.3亿，且增长分布不均，部分欧美老牌馆（如伦敦国家美术馆）仍明显低于疫情前水平。
limitation: 仅统计全球头部100家艺术博物馆的总体客流，受新冠疫情冲击、国际旅游与新馆开放等多重因素影响，无法单独分离数字复制品接触的净贡献。

coverage: 2005年3月至2006年3月美国成年人家庭宽带与互联网普及率调查数据

limitation: 为 Apple 委托 Analysis Group 开展的经济研究摘要；同时披露 1.1 万亿美元中 9,100 亿美元来自实体商品与服务、1,090 亿美元来自应用内广告，直接数字商品与服务销售为 1,040 亿美元，体现商业模式结构差异。

coverage: Apple 官方开发者页面，披露 App Store 17 年内增长至近 200 万款应用、每周访客超 8.5 亿、自 2008 年以来向销售数字商品与服务的开发者累计支付超 5,500 亿美元
excerpt: Apple has paid out over $550B to developers selling digital goods and services since 2008.
limitation: 为 Apple 官方概览页面（未标注具体发表日期），仅反映 iOS 单一封闭生态数据，未披露开发者收入的头部集中度与长尾分布。

coverage: YouTube CEO 2026 年 1 月 21 日官方公开信，披露过去四年向创作者、艺术家和媒体公司支付超 1,000 亿美元，且超 50 万创作者加入 YouTube Shopping
excerpt: In the past four years alone, we’ve paid over $100 billion to creators, artists, and media companies.
limitation: 为平台官方年度信，侧重展示创作者经济总体支付规模与增长，未披露创作者收入中位数及广告分成与直接付费销售的精确比例。

coverage: Google Play 平台规模与变现机制记录：曾汇集超 350 万款 Android 应用（2024 年清理后为 168 万款）、超 500 万册可供购买的电子书，以及 2023 年 12 月 7 亿美元反垄断和解
excerpt: By the end of 2017, Google Play featured more than 3.5 million Android applications. After Google purged many apps from the Google Play Store starting in 2024, there were 1.68 million Android applications in 2024.
limitation: 为维基百科综合条目（无固定发表日期），既提供应用与电子书跨网络销售规模，也记录了平台抽成与反垄断和解等渠道集中边界。

coverage: Apple App Store 反垄断争议与 30% 分成抽成记录（含 Epic Games v. Apple 诉讼及 2025 年 4 月法院裁决）
excerpt: In 2019 and 2020, Apple was frequently criticized by other companies such as Spotify, Airbnb and Hey and regulators for potentially running the App Store as a monopoly and overcharging developers, and was the target of lawsuits and investigations in the EU and United States.
limitation: 为维基百科条目节选（无固定发表日期），作为边界与反面视角说明软件与内容经网络销售并非完全去中心化，而是高度依赖少数超级平台并受制于高额分成与审核壁垒。

coverage: FCC 2003年3月批准Verizon（原Bell Atlantic与NYNEX合并后的RBOC）依据《1996年电信法》第271条进入区域内长途电话（interLATA）市场的官方公告
excerpt: the Federal Communications Commission (Commission) grants the section 271 application of Verizon Maryland Inc., Verizon Washington, DC Inc., West Virginia Inc., Bell Atlantic Communications, Inc. (d/b/a Verizon Long Distance), NYNEX Long Distance Company (d/b/a Verizon Enterprise Solutions)... for authority to enter the interLATA telecommunications market in Maryland, Washington, DC, and West Virginia.
limitation: 仅直接记录Verizon在马里兰、华盛顿特区及西弗吉尼亚州获批第271条长途牌照，未涵盖全部50州及蜂窝业务数据。

coverage: FCC 2007年《BOC独立子公司要求日落令》，记载贝尔运营公司（BOCs）全面进入区域内长途电话服务后的监管框架，以及SBC/AT&T、Verizon/MCI、AT&T/BellSouth合并后仅余AT&T、Qwest、Verizon三家BOC集团的格局
excerpt: The new framework, which applies to AT&T, Qwest, and Verizon... in connection with the SBC/AT&T Order, 20 FCC Rcd 18290 (2005), the Verizon/MCI Order, 20 FCC Rcd 18433 (2005), the AT&T/BellSouth Order, 22 FCC Rcd 5662 (2007)
limitation: 该文件为FCC规章日落令摘要，未逐年列出各家BOC的长途市场份额百分比。

coverage: 美国司法部反垄断局2005年就SBC收购AT&T Corp.案提交的竞争影响声明，记录了七家RBOC的整合历程（SBC先后收购Pacific Telesis和Ameritech）、SBC以160亿美元收购前母公司AT&T Corp.，以及AT&T作为最大IXC和主要CLEC在SBC本地市场竞争的事实
excerpt: SBC, formerly Southwestern Bell, is a regional bell operating company ("RBOC"), formed as part of the seven regional holding companies to result from the breakup of AT&T's local telephone business in 1984. In 1996, SBC acquired another of the seven original holding companies, Pacific Telesis, and in 1999 it acquired a third RBOC, Ameritech.
limitation: 聚焦SBC与AT&T合并案反垄断审查，观察时点截至2005年，未反映2006年后AT&T收购BellSouth及后续无线/宽带竞争。

coverage: 美国司法部2004年就Cingular Wireless（由RBOC公司SBC与BellSouth合资拥有）以410亿美元收购AT&T Wireless案提交的反垄断诉讼与和解公告，反映RBOC无线业务既与AT&T Wireless在移动通信及移动宽带直接竞争、又最终将其并购的双重事实
excerpt: the proposed acquisition of AT&T Wireless Services, Inc. ("AT&T Wireless") by Cingular Wireless Corp. ("Cingular"), which is jointly owned by BellSouth Corporation ("BellSouth") and SBC Communications, Inc. ("SBC"), would violate Section 7 of the Clayton Act, 15 U.S.C. 18 , by substantially lessening competition in the provision of mobile wireless telecommunications services and mobile wireless broadband services.
limitation: 该文件反映2004年移动无线并购审查时点，仅覆盖Cingular与AT&T Wireless，未包含Verizon Wireless的全美数据。

coverage: FCC 2021年《下一代网络与服务时代现代化解绑与转售规则令》，系统统计1996年电信法以来原有本地电话公司（ILECs）从垄断超99%本地语音市场到面临CLECs、有线电视运营商（宽带与互联VoIP）及无线运营商激烈跨界竞争的演变，并披露早期有线电路交换电话渗透缓慢及低密度地区竞争仍不充分的边界
excerpt: Before the enactment of the 1996 Act, incumbent LECs controlled more than 99% of the local voice marketplace... Former monopolist incumbent LECs are now one of many intermodal competitors, facing fierce competition from competitive LECs, cable providers, and wireless providers, among others.
limitation: 统计数据主要截至2019年底（如移动用户3.557亿、互联VoIP 6950万线），且宽带与语音竞争在不同人口密度地区存在显著差异。

coverage: FCC 2026年3月《面向全IP未来改革遗留规则》公告，披露截至2024年6月及2024年12月31日的最新官方语音通信竞争统计：ILECs在固定语音连接中的份额已从1996年的超99%降至25%，非ILEC互联VoIP运营商占多数，且全美仅0.8%的人口普查区缺乏非ILEC竞争者
excerpt: In 1996, incumbent LECs controlled over 99% of the local voice market... Even among fixed voice connections, their share had declined to just 25% by June 2024, with the majority of remaining subscriptions held by non-incumbent LECs offering interconnected VoIP services.
limitation: 该文件为拟议规则制定通知（NPRM）中的市场分析，其引用的实绩数据截至2024年6月与2024年12月31日，不包含2025—2026年更新统计。

coverage: U.S. FCC Wireline Competition Bureau official historical statistics on Telecommunications Act of 1996 local competition, cable VoIP entry (1999-2008), interstate/international long-distance average revenue per minute (1995-2007), and telecommunications carrier/service revenues (1998-2009).
excerpt: FCC Trends in Telephone Service (September 2010): Non-ILEC share of switched access lines and VoIP subscriptions rose from 4.3% (1999) to 27.0% (2008); interstate/international average revenue per minute fell from $0.17 ($0.24 in 2008 dollars) in 1995 to $0.08 in 2007 (international $0.91 to $0.09); end-user toll service revenues fell from $93,311M (1999) to $39,259M (2009); IXC revenues fell from $87,570M (1999) to $37,358M (2008) and ILEC revenues fell from $117,885M (2001) to $89,732M (2008), while wireless carrier revenues grew from $37,032M (1998) to $128,314M (2008).
limitation: Covers U.S. telecommunications market through 2007-2009 (2009 revenue figures preliminary); does not separate pure regulatory causation from technological disruption (wireless and VoIP).

coverage: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) official series CUUR0000SEEE02 (Land-line interstate toll calls, Dec 1997 = 100) and CUUR0000SEED (Telephone services, Dec 1997 = 100) from December 1997 through December 2016.
excerpt: BLS CPI-U series CUUR0000SEEE02 (Land-line interstate toll calls, Dec 1997=100) declined from 100.0 in Dec 1997 to 81.5 in Dec 2000, 58.5 in Dec 2005, 43.791 in Dec 2010, and 32.375 in Dec 2016 (-67.6% nominal), whereas overall Telephone services (CUUR0000SEED) stood at 97.441 in Dec 2016.
limitation: Series starts in December 1997 (two years after the book's 1995 publication) and ends in December 2016 when BLS discontinued the standalone land-line toll sub-index; reflects U.S. urban consumer prices only.

coverage: Peer-reviewed legal and economic critique of the Telecommunications Act of 1996 in the Federal Communications Law Journal (Vol. 58, Issue 3, June 2006) by Gene Kimmelman, Mark Cooper, and Magda Herrera, examining market concentration, RBOC mergers, and local/long-distance competition.
excerpt: Kimmelman, Cooper, & Herrera (FCLJ, June 2006) document that a decade after the 1996 Act, consolidation (SBC-AT&T and Verizon-MCI mergers) left most consumers with at most two choices—the local telephone company or the cable company—with telephone companies still holding 85% of local telephone subscribers in 2005.
limitation: Published in June 2006 as a consumer-advocacy policy critique; reflects the first decade after the 1996 Act prior to the full post-2006 expansion of cable VoIP and smartphone wireless substitution.

coverage: AT&T Inc. Form 10-K Annual Report for the Fiscal Year Ended December 31, 2025 (SEC EDGAR filing, filed February 9, 2026), detailing the secular decline of legacy copper-based voice and data revenues alongside consolidated revenue growth from wireless and fiber broadband.
excerpt: AT&T Inc. FY2025 Form 10-K reports that legacy copper-based voice and data and other transitional services declined to 8% of consolidated operating revenues in 2025 (down from 10% in 2024 and 13% in 2023), while Wireless service (54%), Equipment (18%), and Fiber and advanced connectivity (13%) drove total consolidated operating revenues to $125,648 million.
limitation: Company-level SEC filing for AT&T Inc. (the largest U.S. incumbent telecom successor after acquiring BellSouth, Pacific Telesis, Ameritech, and AT&T Corp.); combines legacy voice and legacy data within 'Legacy and other transitional' rather than isolating long-distance voice alone.

coverage: 47 U.S.C. § 254(k) (Telecommunications Act of 1996): federal statutory prohibition against telecommunications carriers using non-competitive regulated services to cross-subsidize competitive services.
excerpt: A telecommunications carrier may not use services that are not competitive to subsidize services that are subject to competition.
limitation: Establishes the statutory anti-cross-subsidization rule enacted in 1996, but does not by itself measure whether carriers experienced cash shortages or how strictly state PUCs enforced cost allocation in practice.

coverage: Associated Press report (published via Business Insider, March 26, 2010) on Verizon winding down its $23 billion FiOS fiber-to-the-home expansion, leaving a third of its footprint without fiber, and noting investor skepticism over project costs.
excerpt: It costs Verizon thousands of dollars to connect a home to FiOS, and it has faced skepticism from investors over the project. The cost from its 2004 introduction to 2010 was put at $23 billion in 2007.
limitation: Focuses primarily on Verizon's 2004-2010 FiOS rollout and briefly notes AT&T and Qwest's lower-cost copper-last-mile strategy; does not cover later fiber expansions after 2010 or quantify shareholder voting outcomes.

coverage: USTelecom 2024 Broadband Capex Report (published October 21, 2025) tracking U.S. broadband communications infrastructure capital expenditure from 1996 through 2024.
excerpt: America’s broadband providers invested $89.6 billion in U.S. communications infrastructure in 2024. The continued strong pace of investment, topping $2.2 trillion since 1996, underscores broadband’s essential role in powering the U.S. economy at the dawning age of artificial intelligence.
limitation: Industry trade association aggregate across all U.S. broadband providers (including wireline telcos, wireless carriers, and cable operators), so it does not isolate legacy regulated wireline telephone subsidiaries alone.

coverage: Ars Technica report (June 9, 2015) on Pennsylvania regulators freeing Verizon predecessor Bell Atlantic from rate-of-return regulation and allowing higher phone rates in exchange for a 1993 universal fiber commitment, and the resulting 2015 deployment shortfall.
excerpt: In exchange, Verizon was allowed to charge higher phone rates. (More specifically, the company was freed from the restrictions of rate-of-return regulation.) But today, at least 2.1 million Pennsylvania households in Verizon’s phone territory do not have access to the company’s fiber network.
limitation: Single-state case study (Pennsylvania) of one RBOC successor (Bell Atlantic/Verizon), illustrating that state rate commissions did in some jurisdictions relax rate regulation rather than uniformly blocking rate increases.

coverage: Verizon Communications Inc. FY2025 Form 10-K (SEC EDGAR, filed February 17, 2026) reporting $17.0 billion in 2025 network/fiber/5G capital expenditures alongside $11.5 billion in cash dividends and the 19th consecutive annual quarterly dividend increase.
excerpt: During the year ended December 31, 2025, these investments included $17.0 billion for capital expenditures. This is the nineteenth consecutive year that Company’s Board of Directors has approved a quarterly dividend increase. During 2025, we paid $11.5 billion in dividends.
limitation: Reflects consolidated Verizon Communications (successor to RBOCs Bell Atlantic and NYNEX plus wireless operations), where wireless cash flows and capital markets helped sustain both heavy capex and uninterrupted dividend growth.

coverage: U S WEST, Inc. Form S-4 (SEC EDGAR, filed May 12, 1995) explaining the RBOC's recapitalization into dividend-oriented Communications Stock and non-dividend multimedia/broadband Media Stock due to income-oriented investors discounting its multimedia assets.
excerpt: The Existing Common Stock trades at a discount to its theoretical public market trading value (the estimated stand-alone public trading value of the component businesses that comprise the Company), primarily due to the relatively low value that dividend yield and income oriented investors attribute to the businesses that comprise the Media Group.
limitation: Filed May 12, 1995, approximately six months prior to the November 1995 publication of The Road Ahead; therefore used strictly as baseline background context confirming the initial investor tension rather than post-publication proof.

coverage: AT&T Inc. FY2022 Form 10-K (SEC EDGAR, filed February 13, 2023) documenting the reduction in declared common stock dividends from $2.08 per share in 2021 to $1.11 per share in 2022.
excerpt: We declared dividends on common stock, on a quarterly basis, totaling $1.11 per share in 2022 and $2.08 per share in 2021.
limitation: AT&T (consolidator of four RBOCs: SBC, Pacific Telesis, Ameritech, and BellSouth) maintained a $2.08/share dividend through 2021; its 2022 dividend reset to $1.11/share coincided with the WarnerMedia spin-off as well as capital reallocation toward fiber and 5G, so it cannot be attributed solely to broadband network capex.

coverage: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation (NTT) Form 20-F for fiscal year ended March 31, 2001: ISDN subscriber growth (INS-Net 64 / 1500), flat-rate home Internet service (FLET'S ISDN), ISDN tariff reductions, and audited ISDN operating revenues (FY1999-FY2001).
excerpt: NTT Form 20-F (FY2001): ISDN operating revenues grew from 556 billion yen (5.7%) in FY1999 to 819 billion yen (7.9%) in FY2000 and 1,082 billion yen (9.6% of total operating revenues) in FY2001, driven by flat-rate home Internet FLET'S ISDN and rate reductions, with INS-Net 64 subscribers rising 44.9% to 9.6 million.
limitation: Covers Japan's incumbent telecom carrier (NTT) for fiscal years ended March 31, 1999-2001; reflects NTT's ISDN mass-market peak before subsequent ADSL and FTTH migration in Japan.

coverage: Deutsche Telekom AG Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2002: T-ISDN mass-market installed base in Germany (2000-2002), lower-usage rate plans for individual/SME Internet access, and access revenue growth from analog-to-ISDN migration.
excerpt: Deutsche Telekom Form 20-F (FY2002): Basic ISDN access lines in Germany grew from 7.2 million (2000) to 8.6 million (2001) and 9.7 million (2002, 22.4 million channels), supported by multiple lower-usage rate plans for Internet access; migration from analog to ISDN access increased access revenues.
limitation: Covers Germany's incumbent carrier Deutsche Telekom for 2000-2002; access revenue growth in 2002 also reflects bundled T-DSL growth and regulator-approved 2%-5% access line price increases, and ISDN was later phased out as VoIP/DSL replaced it.

coverage: FCC First Section 706 Report (FCC 99-5, CC Docket No. 98-146, Released February 2, 1999): U.S. consumer first-year costs for ISDN vs Cable Modems and ADSL, and U.S. residential cable modem subscriber counts at year-end 1998.
excerpt: FCC 99-5 (Feb 1999): In the U.S., consumer first-year cost for ISDN was $1,385 (Bits per Buck 1.6) versus $593 for Cable Modems (75.0) and $960 for ADSL (27.3); meanwhile cable television companies had at least 350,000 residential broadband customers (other estimates 425,000 to 700,000) at the end of 1998.
limitation: Covers the U.S. residential market as of late 1998; FCC notes the 350,000 cable modem count is a conservative minimum estimate and classifies ISDN as narrowband rather than broadband (>200 Kbps).

coverage: FCC Statistics of Communications Common Carriers (1997/1998 Edition, Table 2.10): Official U.S. Basic Rate ISDN control channels and residential digital access lines as of December 31, 1997.
excerpt: FCC SOCC (as of Dec 31, 1997): Reporting U.S. local exchange carriers had 1,108,630 Basic Rate ISDN control channels and 66,320 Primary Rate ISDN control channels, while residential digital switched access lines (64 Kbps or equiv) totaled only 103,078.
limitation: Covers U.S. reporting local exchange carriers (ARMIS filers) as of year-end 1997; BRI ISDN control channels include both business and residential subscribers, and exact month/day of publication is not printed on the report cover.

coverage: FCC Statistics of Communications Common Carriers (1999 Edition, Released August 11, 2000, Table 2.6): Official U.S. Basic Rate ISDN control channels and residential digital switched access lines as of December 31, 1999.
excerpt: FCC SOCC (released Aug 11, 2000, data as of Dec 31, 1999): U.S. Basic Rate ISDN control channels reached 1,753,075 (Primary Rate 263,854), but residential digital switched access lines were only 357,052 out of 115.2 million residential lines.
limitation: Covers U.S. reporting local exchange carriers as of year-end 1999; Basic Rate ISDN control channels aggregate business and residential lines, whereas residential digital lines (357,052) show limited U.S. consumer residential uptake.

coverage: FCC Trends in Telephone Service (Released May 22, 2002, Tables 2.1 and 2.3): Official U.S. Coaxial Cable (cable modem) and ADSL high-speed lines from December 1999 through June 2001.
excerpt: FCC Trends in Telephone Service (May 22, 2002): U.S. coaxial cable high-speed lines (>200 Kbps) grew from 1,411,977 in December 1999 (1,402,394 residential/small business) to 2,284,491 in June 2000, 3,582,874 in December 2000, and 5,184,141 in June 2001, rapidly overtaking U.S. BRI ISDN.
limitation: FCC high-speed data collection began in December 1999 and measures lines over 200 Kbps in at least one direction, so it does not directly report pre-1999 cable modem counts or narrowband ISDN counts.

coverage: 2000–2026年美国成年人互联网使用率、家庭宽带订阅率及纯智能手机上网比例调查数据（Pew Research Center）
excerpt: When the Center began asking Americans about their internet usage in early 2000, about half of all adults were already online. Today, 97% of U.S. adults say they use the internet. The share of U.S. adults with high-speed broadband service at home increased rapidly between 2000 and 2010. And that growth continues today: 78% of U.S. adults now say they subscribe to a broadband internet service at home.
limitation: 仅覆盖美国成年人端需求普及率，起始调查年份为2000年（晚于1995年出版年），未直接给出通信与有线企业收入或利润数据。

coverage: Comcast Corporation 2025财年Form 10-K（截至2025-12-31）：有线宽带、无线、视频业务收入、用户变动、Connectivity & Platforms调整后EBITDA利润率及竞争风险披露
excerpt: Total Connectivity & Platforms Adjusted EBITDA margin 40.0 % 40.4 % (40) bps (20) bps. Domestic broadband customers decreased by 711,000 to 31.3 million. Domestic wireless lines increased by 1.5 million to 9.3 million. Domestic video customers decreased by 1.3 million to 11.3 million.
limitation: 属于单一龙头有线企业（Comcast）财报且包含英国/意大利Sky业务及媒体内容板块；未覆盖全行业所有中小有线运营商。

coverage: Charter Communications, Inc. 2025财年Form 10-K（截至2025-12-31）：美国第二大有线运营商总收入、调整后EBITDA、营业利润、宽带与移动用户变动及竞争态势
excerpt: Revenues $ 54,774 $ 55,085 (0.6) %. Adjusted EBITDA $ 22,708 $ 22,569 0.6 %. Income from operations $ 12,908 $ 13,118 (1.6) %. Residential Internet customers decreased by 393,000 in 2025 compared to 2024. Residential mobile lines increased by 1.8 million in 2025 compared to 2024.
limitation: 属于美国单一有线电视与宽带运营商财报，反映美国住宅市场结构，不直接代表欧洲或发展中国家有线运营商盈利水平。

coverage: Verizon Communications Inc. 2025财年Form 10-K（截至2025-12-31）：美国最大电信运营商营收、营业利润、FWA与光纤宽带增长、政企与批发下滑及跨界竞争披露
excerpt: Consolidated Operating Revenues $ 138,191 $ 134,788 $ 133,974. Consolidated operating income 29,259 28,686 22,877. The telecommunications industry is highly competitive. The rapid development of new technologies, services and products has eliminated many of the distinctions among wireless, cable, internet and traditional telephone services and brought new competitors to our markets.
limitation: 仅覆盖Verizon一家美国大型电信公司，其营收与利润由无线移动与宽带共同驱动，无法单独剥离所有历史固话资产。

coverage: AT&T Inc. 2025财年Form 10-K（截至2025-12-31）：美国大型电信公司总营业利润率、移动与家庭光纤宽带盈利能力，以及政企传统有线业务亏损分化
excerpt: Our operating margin was 19.2% in 2025, compared to 15.6% in 2024, and 19.2% in 2023. Our Mobility EBITDA margin was 42.0% in 2025, 42.8% in 2024 and 40.9% in 2023. Our Business Wireline operating income margin was (4.7)% in 2025, (0.5)% in 2024 and 6.2% in 2023. Our Consumer Wireline EBITDA margin was 37.0% in 2025, 33.4% in 2024 and 31.3% in 2023.
limitation: 仅反映AT&T（原区域贝尔运营商SBC整合而来）财务表现，不包含已分拆的华纳媒体历史资产。

coverage: Vodafone Group Plc FY2026 Form 20-F（截至2026-03-31）：欧洲高度竞争电信市场中比特传输运营商的盈利承压、ARPU下滑与持续经营亏损
excerpt: Basic loss per share from continuing operations was 1.20 eurocents in FY26, compared to a loss per share of 15.86 eurocents in the prior year, following the impairment charges in FY25. In Portugal, service revenue declined during the year as a result of mobile ARPU pressure, due to competitive intensity in the market following the launch of a fourth operator.
limitation: 反映欧洲及部分新兴市场多运营商竞争环境下的单一跨国电信集团表现，受减值与区域组合调整影响。

coverage: 英国及爱尔兰数字卫星电视运营商 British Sky Broadcasting Group plc (BSkyB) 2002年 Form 20-F 年报，覆盖1999年5月推出免费机顶盒计划至2002年6月30日补贴支出与DTH订户增长
excerpt: In 1999 when we added further subsidy to the set-top box to bring the price down to zero, this also was available to consumers regardless of whether they elected to take a subscription to any services provided by us. From January 1, 2002, we offered the free set-top box with a requirement to subscribe to our services.
limitation: 仅反映英国与爱尔兰卫星电视市场（BSkyB）案例，且订户仍需支付安装费，不能代表全球所有比特分发公司。

coverage: 美国卫星电视运营商 DISH Network Corporation 2007财年 Form 10-K 年报（2008-02-26提交），覆盖1996年3月开播至2007年12月31日接收机补贴、租赁获客策略及订户规模
excerpt: In addition to leasing receivers to subscribers, we generally subsidize installation and all or a part of the cost of the receivers as an incentive to attract subscribers. Since we subsidize consumer up-front costs, we incur significant costs each time we acquire a new subscriber.

excerpt: The applications are accessible from various client devices through either a thin client interface, such as a web browser (e.g., web-based email), or a program interface. coverage: 2026年11月发表的端侧大语言模型部署实践综述（arXiv:2611.09075），同时反映了前沿AI模型因资源需求高而受限于移动/边缘设备、以及软硬件优化推动端侧本地智能部署进展的双向现状。
excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed many areas of artificial intelligence (AI), but their substantial resource requirements limit their deployment on mobile and edge devices. Although LLMs have demonstrated impressive capabilities in various applications, the next challenge is deploying these models on resource-limited edge devices. Recent innovations in software optimizations and specialized hardware have made it feasible to deploy LLMs on edge devices. Edge deployment offers benefits including local data processing, cost savings, reduced latency, and personalized responses.
limitation: 属于学术预印本综述，聚焦大语言模型（LLM）在边缘与移动设备上的部署可行性与技术路径，并非全网所有软件工作负载的统计普查。

coverage: 2026年5月发表的云端与端侧混合多智能体系统研究（arXiv:2605.30102），揭示了2026年智能体AI推理仍呈两极分化：前沿大模型主要托管于云端，端侧主要运行小模型，云端与端侧混合架构尚未成为最普遍选择。
excerpt: The design space of agentic AI inference spans two extremes: frontier large language models (LLMs), typically hosted in the cloud and offering strong performance across a wide range of tasks at substantially high cost, and more cost-efficient small language models (SLMs), which are amenable to on-device inference. Hybrid multi-agent systems (MASs) combining on-device and cloud models offer a promising middle ground, but they also introduce a complex and poorly understood design space in which task accuracy, monetary cost, and edge energy consumption are tightly coupled; in the absence of general design principles, hybrid components, although not the most prevalent choice, are typically introduced through ad hoc decisions tailored to specific domains.
limitation: 聚焦智能体AI推理架构（LLM/SLM），反映的是2026年前沿AI工作负载的分布失衡，不代表全部传统Web或本地桌面软件。

coverage: Google研究团队发表于IEEE Micro（2003）的里程碑论文，直接记录了支撑全球互联网搜索的超大规模服务器架构采用超过1.5万台商品化PC级机器集群加容错软件，以远低于昂贵高端服务器的成本获得更优性能。
